guide.title: Veny_Sound Getting Started Guide
guide.subtitle: Learn how to get the most out of Veny_Sound
guide.forListenersDesc: Discover music on Veny_Sound and learn how to support your favorite artists.
guide.browseMusicDesc: Explore all registered music on the Music page. Use the search bar to find tracks by artist or title. Use genre filters to browse by category such as Pop, K-Pop, World Music, and more.
guide.playMusicDesc: Click the play button on a track card to open the global player at the bottom. Playback continues when you navigate to other pages. Use previous/next track buttons to skip. Use Play All to play an entire list. Listening time is recorded and you can view total streaming time on your profile.
guide.likeAndFollowDesc: Tap the heart on tracks you like. Liked tracks are saved on your profile. Follow artists to get notified when they upload new music.
guide.playlistsDesc: Create playlists and add your favorite tracks. Use "Add to Playlist" from a track card menu to add songs. Create, manage, and delete playlists from your profile.
guide.tipAndPurchaseDesc: Support artists with credits. Choose an amount (minimum 100 KRW) and add a message. Purchase tracks that have paid download enabled and download them. You can buy credits on the Credits page.
guide.communityDesc: Connect with other users on the community board. Post in categories like General, Recommendations, Collab, and Info. Join discussions with comments and replies.
guide.popularAndNotificationsDesc: Check the Popular page for the TOP 10 most-liked tracks. Get notifications for new uploads from followed artists, tips, and copyright report results.
guide.premiumMembershipDesc: Premium subscription unlocks features like AI cover image generation. Choose monthly (9,900 KRW) or yearly (99,000 KRW). Secure payment via Toss Payments.
guide.forArtistsDesc: Learn how to upload music, connect with fans, and earn revenue on Veny_Sound.
guide.uploadMusicDesc: Upload tracks in MP3, WAV, or OGG on the Upload page. Set title, artist, genre, and tags. Add a cover image or use random cover. Check "AI track" for AI-generated music.
guide.bulkUploadDesc: Upload multiple tracks at once. Select multiple files and apply artist, genre, and AI setting in bulk. You can also set title, tags, and cover per track.
guide.monetizationDesc: Enable paid download so listeners can purchase tracks with credits. Set a price from 100 KRW. Tips from listeners also go to your earnings. View balance, tips, and sales on your profile Earnings tab and request withdrawal. A 15% fee (plus tax) applies to withdrawals.
guide.manageMusicDesc: Edit your uploads anytime. Change title, artist, genre, tags, AI flag, and cover image. You can also delete tracks if needed.
guide.fanCommunicationDesc: Followers get notified when you upload new music. Connect with fans on the community board and find collaboration partners. View followers and following on your profile.
guide.copyrightProtectionDesc: Veny_Sound runs a copyright report system. Report unauthorized use, plagiarism, or false attribution. Admins review and take action. You get notified of the result. Check report status on your profile.
guide.premiumBenefitsDesc: Premium subscribers can use AI cover image generation when uploading. A Premium badge on your profile builds trust as an artist.

about.title: The Veny Sound Story
about.subtitle: Our journey connecting the world through music
about.logoSlogan: "The space where your emotions meet the beat, Veny_sound"
about.logoDesc: The Veny_sound logo carries rich and dynamic meanings as a music sharing platform. Here's the symbolism behind each element.
about.symbol1Text1: The intertwined brand initials symbolize the meeting point of artists (Veny, venue/provider) and music (Sound).
about.symbol1Text2: The blend of cool blue (technology, trust) and warm orange (passion, emotion) represents the harmony of digital technology and human musical sensibility.
about.symbol2Text1: The freely flowing curves breaking from conventional forms represent the rhythm of music and the coexistence of diverse genres.
about.symbol2Text2: They represent the spread of joy as users freely share and discover music within the platform.
about.symbol3Text1: The digital bars placed around the text show the vitality of living music, suggesting a smart platform that responds to users' tastes in real-time.
about.symbol3Text2: The equalizer bars wrapping around the text symbolize the role of connecting users through music.
about.symbol4Text: The underscore, commonly used in social media handles and code, shows a platform targeting the trendy digital generation, visually expressing the bridge between 'space (Veny)' and 'sound (Sound)'.
about.logoSummary: Overall, this logo conveys the message of "a hub where anyone can freely enjoy and share music, with artistic sensibility layered on top of technical perfection."
about.missionDesc: Veny Sound was created to build a platform where anyone can share their music with the world and communicate through music beyond borders and languages. We provide opportunities for artists and new inspiration for listeners.
about.creativityDesc: We believe creativity can change the world. We respect and support all forms of musical endeavor.
about.communityDesc: Music is more beautiful when shared together. We strive for a healthy and open community.
about.trustDesc: We protect artists' copyrights and promise transparent and fair platform operation.
about.contactDesc: Have questions about Veny Sound? Feel free to reach out anytime.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.a1: Veny Sound is a music streaming platform where anyone can upload and share their music. It provides a space for artists and listeners to connect through music.
faq.a2: After logging in, click the 'Upload' button in the top menu to upload audio files (MP3, WAV, OGG). You can enter information such as title, artist name, genre, and also register an album cover image.
faq.q3: What audio file formats are supported?
faq.a3: Currently MP3, WAV, and OGG formats are supported, with a maximum file size of 50MB.
faq.a4: Click the 'Log In' button to sign in with Google, Naver, or Kakao. Use 'Dev Login' for local testing.
faq.q5: How do I use the community board?
faq.a5: After logging in, you can write posts or leave comments on others' posts in the Community menu. You can use various categories such as music recommendations, questions, and information sharing.
faq.a6: Yes, AI-generated tracks can also be uploaded. Simply check the 'This is an AI-generated track' checkbox when uploading.
faq.q7: Where can I contact for inquiries?
faq.a7: You can email support@venysound.com or call 02-1234-5678.

creativity.title: Creativity
creativity.subtitle: We respect all musical endeavors
creativity.description: Veny Sound believes creativity can change the world. We encourage new attempts that break the boundaries of genres and existing frameworks, creating an environment where all artists can freely express their musical world.
creativity.detail1Text: Experimental sounds, crossover genres, unique productions — any musical attempt is welcome at Veny Sound.
creativity.detail2Text: We provide tools including AI cover image generation, high-quality streaming, and a detailed genre classification system.
creativity.detail3Text: From indie to hip-hop, R&B, electronic, classical, and world music — Veny Sound supports all genres equally.
creativity.quote: Music has no limits. If there are limits, they are only the limits of imagination.

community.title: Community
community.subtitle: The beauty of music shared together
community.description: Music creates greater emotion when shared together than when listened to alone. The Veny Sound community is a space where artists and listeners connect, exchange inspiration, and grow together.
community.detail1Text: Artists and listeners can communicate directly through likes, reviews, and follow systems.
community.detail2Text: Share stories about music freely on category-based community boards.
community.detail3Text: Experience becoming one through music beyond borders and languages. Veny Sound aims to be a global platform for music lovers worldwide.
community.quote: Music is the universal language. Where words fail, music speaks.

trust.title: Trust
trust.subtitle: A transparent and fair platform
trust.description: We protect artists' copyrights and promise transparent and fair platform operation.
trust.detail1Text: We protect artists' creations from illegal copying and unauthorized use through a systematic copyright reporting system.
trust.detail2Text: We apply the same standards to all users based on clear terms of service and fair policies.
trust.detail3Text: We provide real-time updates on copyright report processing status and community activities through our notification system.
trust.quote: Trust is not built overnight. It starts with keeping your promises every day.

sunoGuide.heroDesc: No instruments or composition knowledge needed. With Suno AI, you can create your own music with just a few lines of text.
sunoGuide.heroCredit: Sign up and make 10 songs to get 250 free credits
sunoGuide.promptDesc: Copy the examples below and paste them directly into Suno!

steps.title: Go to suno.com and log in
steps.desc: Free login with Google, Discord, or Microsoft account. 50 free credits daily (about 10 songs)

steps.title: Click the Create button
steps.desc: Click the 'Create' button at the top or sidebar to open the music creation screen.

steps.title: Enter a prompt
steps.desc: Enter your desired music style, mood, and genre in English. Refer to the examples below!

steps.title: Fine-tune with Custom Mode
steps.desc: Turn on 'Custom Mode' to write the title, lyrics, and style yourself. Korean lyrics are also supported!

steps.title: Generate & Download
steps.desc: Press Create to generate 2 versions. Choose your favorite and download it as an MP3.

examples.result: A bright and upbeat K-pop female vocal track with an addictive chorus themed around summer love
examples.tip: Inputting genre + vocal gender + mood + BPM + theme together gives more accurate results.

examples.result: An emotional solo piano piece with a rainy day atmosphere. Healing music with a film OST feel
examples.tip: For instrumentals without lyrics, always include 'no lyrics' or 'instrumental'.

examples.result: Korean trap hip-hop about city life with heavy 808 bass and storytelling rap
examples.tip: For hip-hop, the more specific you are about beat style (trap/boom bap/lofi hip-hop), the better.

examples.result: Progressive house with festival vibes, an intense drop, and euphoric melody
examples.tip: For EDM, specifying the sub-genre (house/techno/dubstep/drum and bass) and BPM together is effective.

examples.result: A Korean male ballad themed around heartbreak with acoustic guitar and string arrangements
examples.tip: For ballads, clearly describe the emotion (melancholic/hopeful/nostalgic) and instrumentation.

examples.result: Smooth café jazz influenced by bossa nova, centered around saxophone and piano
examples.tip: For café atmosphere, adjectives like 'cozy', 'warm', and 'smooth' work well.

tipsList: Prompts written in English give more accurate results. Try using Google Translate.
If you want to write your own lyrics, enter Korean lyrics in Custom Mode.
Generating multiple times with similar prompts gives you various versions.
You can extend a song you like with 'Extend' or improve quality with 'Remaster'.
Upload your finished music to Veny Sound and share it with others!
